baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah names spouses and what right hands possess, then predicates non-blame of those two exceptions.
baseline_models.mechanism: Marital pairing and right-hand possession supply two distinct, enumerated relational channels. Otherness and negation narrow the removal of reproach to those channels, so non-blame is bounded rather than free-standing.

activation_trace.role: The spouse branch supplies the first marital channel as a paired counterpart in marriage.
Ownership and disposal supply the status-bearing possession relation of the second channel.
The right hand and right side supply the embodied agency to which the possession is attributed.
Otherness, exception, and negation turn blame into its expressly delimited contrary.
Reproach for a blameworthy act supplies the accountability predicate that is removed inside the exceptions.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply permits intimate access to two categories.
changed_reading.after: The ayah marks two distinct relational jurisdictions inside which blame is suspended; it does not announce an unbounded absence of blame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Pairing, possession, right-hand pledge, and non-blame converge within the focus construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The alternatives remain distinct, yet branch images of marital pairing, marriage contracting, and sworn pledge make both publicly legible bonds rather than accidental availability. Non-blame follows recognized relation, not appetite alone.

activation_trace.role: Joining one counterpart to another makes the first route an established pairing.
The marriage-contract branch contributes formal authorization without collapsing possession into marriage.
The oath branch adds a secondary resonance of pledged obligation to right-hand possession.
Blame as accountable reproach makes recognized authorization the mechanism of exemption.

changed_reading.before: The two exceptions are unrelated objects of lawful access.
changed_reading.after: They are distinct relations made legible by pairing, status, or pledge, with non-blame attached to the recognized bond.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins paired counterparts, possession, right-hand force, and exemption from blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pairing gives a two-part relation, while the cohesion and mainstay branches of possession and the rightful-force branch of the right hand make authorized intimacy a structure capable of bearing responsibility. The model reads the exceptions as stabilizing channels rather than mere outlets.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart joined to its pair supplies the relational unit that replaces solitary appetite.
Strength and cohesion contribute the capacity of the authorized relation to hold together.
The mainstay of a matter makes possession a responsibility-bearing support rather than control alone.
Rightful force and restraint supply bounded agency within the relation.

changed_reading.before: Lawful intimacy is defined only by who is available.
changed_reading.after: Lawful intimacy is also imagined as entering a relation that can cohere, restrain power, and carry responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier naming of the spouse through companionship and abiding presence sharpens the focus's spouse branch as reciprocal association. The focus's explicit alternative then prevents the spouse category from being flattened into the possession syntax of the second category.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and abiding presence give the contextual spouse a reciprocal relational profile.
The spouse branch anchors that companionship directly in the first focus exception.
Ownership and disposal mark the different mechanism used by the second exception.

structural_cues: 70:11-14 distinguishes spouse, children, brother, clan, and all humanity as separate relational positions in the failed ransom sequence.
The focus separates spouses from right-hand possession with an explicit alternative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spouse-as-companionship and two separately named focus categories; I infer that the first carries reciprocity and should not be absorbed into the ownership mechanism of the second. A live alternative is that companionship in 70:12 only names kinship within the ransom scene.

changed_reading.before: Both focus categories can be heard under a single logic of availability.
changed_reading.after: The spouse route is reciprocal companionship, while the possession route remains a distinct status relation; the ayah does not equate them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context diagnoses a rapidly disturbed, grasping human response to what touches it, then turns to stable practice. Branches of sexual touching and abstention from indecency let that diagnosis enter the focus domain: the exceptions regulate intimate impulse through durable channels rather than simply satisfying it.

activation_trace.role: Anxious greed and rapid disturbance supply the unstable appetite that the ensuing practices train.
The sexual-touch branch inside the broader touch verb links the human response pattern to the focus's intimate domain.
Abstention from indecency turns withholding into a possible form of sexual self-restraint rather than grasping alone.
Stillness and continuity supply the durable counterforce to rapid disturbance.
Established pairing gives intimate impulse a stable relational channel.

structural_cues: 70:20-21 repeats the same touch construction for adversity and good, exposing a symmetric reactive pattern.
The exception at 70:22 opens a sequence of durable practices that reaches guarding and the focus exceptions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies volatility, touch, restraint, continuity, and the later guarded intimate construction; I infer one training sequence from reactive appetite to regulated relation. A live alternative keeps touch limited to affliction and restraint limited to wealth, making the sexual linkage only branch-level resonance.

changed_reading.before: The focus lists permitted satisfaction after an unrelated moral inventory.
changed_reading.after: The focus is one stage in retraining volatile appetite: intimacy becomes non-blameworthy when received through a stable, guarded relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby property scene places a fixed claim inside wealth for someone otherwise deprived. That structure changes possession in the focus from self-authorizing control into a jurisdiction already burdened by another's standing claim and by duties of restraint.

activation_trace.role: Acquired and accumulated wealth supplies the context's explicit possession domain.
A specific right owned by its holder places another person's enforceable claim inside what someone possesses.
Deprivation and loss identify the vulnerable claimant whom possession must not erase.
Ownership and disposal anchor the context's rights-bearing correction in the focus possession verb.
Rightful force and restraint recast possession as accountable power rather than unrestricted disposal.

structural_cues: The known right in wealth immediately precedes accountability, fear, bodily guarding, and the focus exception within one repeated character list.
The focus predicates non-blame rather than declaring possession itself unlimited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth containing another's fixed right and focus possession marked by right-hand force; I infer that possession generally carries duties toward the person within its reach. A live alternative confines the known-right mechanism to money and leaves the intimate category legally separate.

changed_reading.before: Possession itself appears to authorize whatever occurs within the second category.
changed_reading.after: Possession authorizes only as an accountable relation bearing claims and restraints; it is not a blank license over a person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reckoning and testimony frame blame as an assessable standing before judgment. The focus's non-blame therefore reads less as freedom from social embarrassment and more as a bounded verdict about conduct inside named relations.

activation_trace.role: Account and recompense supply the adjudicative horizon in which blame has consequences.
Testimony as knowledgeable declaration makes moral standing publicly attestable rather than merely felt.
Reproach for a blameworthy act becomes the verdict negated under the focus conditions.

structural_cues: The focus sits between affirmation of the day of account and later standing by testimony.
Fear of unsecured punishment directly precedes guarding and the non-blame clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, testimony, and the focus predicate of blame; I infer an adjudicative status connecting them. A live alternative hears blame as ordinary moral reproach without a specifically forensic force.

changed_reading.before: Not blamed means that others should not censure the permitted conduct.
changed_reading.after: Not blamed is a bounded accountable verdict, legible within the surah's sequence of reckoning and testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding body term carries both sexual anatomy and the image of a vulnerable opening, while guarding includes protection of sanctity, covenant, and chastity. The focus exceptions therefore specify controlled openings within an active guard; they do not cancel guarding.

activation_trace.role: An open frontier vulnerable to danger spatializes the sexual body as an aperture requiring a boundary.
Protection of sanctity, covenant, and chastity supplies the continuing guard around that aperture.
Exception and negation define where the guard may open without producing blame.
The spouse branch names one controlled opening in the guarded intimate boundary.

structural_cues: 70:29 states guarding, 70:30 opens named exceptions, and 70:31 labels movement beyond them.
The exception is syntactically subordinate to the ongoing description of those who guard.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a vulnerable-opening branch, chastity-guarding, and an adjacent exception; I infer a regulated-gate mechanism in which permitted access remains guarded. A live alternative treats guarding as simple abstention and the two exceptions as categorical carve-outs without spatial force.

changed_reading.before: The exceptions temporarily switch off the command to guard.
changed_reading.after: The exceptions are the guarded boundary's authorized openings, so vigilance and responsibility continue inside them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah converts the focus alternatives into a perimeter: desire that seeks on the far side becomes crossing and injustice. This supplies the positive complement of non-blame and makes the focus a boundary rule rather than a freestanding inventory.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping a limit through aggression colors the act of seeking as desire that exceeds its authorized scope.
The side beyond, behind, or apart supplies the spatial exterior of the focus alternatives.
Crossing the limit and doing injustice names the result of moving outside the perimeter.
Exception and negation establish the inside whose outside is then named as transgression.
Blame marks the accountability contrast that limit-crossing reactivates.

structural_cues: The singular deictic in 70:31 points back to the just-stated pair of exceptions as one bounded field.
The conditional consequence immediately follows the focus without a topic break.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeking, a beyond-side, and explicit limit-crossing immediately after the focus; I infer an inside/outside perimeter around the two exceptions. A live alternative reads beyond only as 'other than' and does not materialize a spatial boundary.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely lists cases that carry no blame.
changed_reading.after: The focus draws the inside edge of a rule whose outside is active overreaching and injustice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Trust, preserved covenant, and continuing care immediately follow the sexual boundary. They activate the oath branch of right hand and the responsibility side of possession, making intimate authorization something held in trust and tended over time rather than exercised once.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust supply the protected condition expected of entrusted relations.
A preserved covenant that secures its holder gives authorization an enduring pledged form.
Sustaining and tending a covenant turns the bond into continuing care rather than static status.
The oath branch makes right-hand possession resonate with pledged obligation without replacing its ordinary right-hand sense.
Ownership and disposal become the power that covenantal care constrains and directs.

structural_cues: Trusts, covenant, and tending directly follow the focus boundary as the next member of the same repeated character list.
The plural possessive pronouns recur across right hands, trusts, and covenant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate trust-and-covenant language plus a focus root with an oath branch; I infer that possession and pairing are responsibilities held under pledge. A live alternative keeps right hands purely literal and treats trust and covenant as an independent virtue.

changed_reading.before: The named relation removes blame by status alone.
changed_reading.after: The named relation removes blame as a tended trust: authorization carries an ongoing covenantal duty toward the other party.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later coordinated right and left sides re-literalize the focus root as embodied or spatial orientation. This checks an overstrong covenant-only reading: oath remains a secondary resonance, while right-hand possession remains the lexical base.

activation_trace.role: The explicit right side supplies a later literal occurrence of the same right-hand branch.
The left side as the contrary of the right confirms the bodily and spatial opposition.
The oath branch is the reading being retained only as resonance rather than promoted to the focus gloss.

structural_cues: 70:37 coordinates right and left with matching prepositions in a visible side-to-side contrast.
The focus expression already combines possession with the plural right-hand noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later literal right-versus-left contrast; I carry that sense back to constrain the oath activation at the focus. A live alternative treats the possession formula as lexicalized enough that the later spatial occurrence adds no disambiguating force.

changed_reading.before: The covenant context could make the focus right-hand noun primarily an oath or pledge.
changed_reading.after: The bodily right-hand sense remains primary, while oath and pledge survive as a contained obligation resonance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing assertion joins divine lordship, capacity that reaches action and possession, and replacement of one party by another. Against that scale, focus ownership becomes finite and delegated: human control cannot become autonomous dominion over the relation.

activation_trace.role: Capacity sufficient for action and ownership supplies the superior power asserted in the closing scene.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty establish the encompassing dominion under which human possession operates.
One thing standing in another's place shows that human holders themselves remain replaceable.
Kingship and dominion expose the maximal ownership sense that the context relocates under divine sovereignty.
Ordinary ownership and disposal remain the focus sense but are reduced from sovereignty to delegated jurisdiction.

structural_cues: 70:40-41 moves from the Lord of all horizons to the power to replace the present human group.
The focus's human possessive construction is grammatically local, while the closing sovereignty claim is universal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine sovereignty, effective capacity, and human replaceability; I infer that focus possession is subordinate jurisdiction rather than autonomous mastery. A live alternative keeps the closing replacement claim eschatological and unrelated to the legal force of 70:30.

changed_reading.before: What the right hand possesses can sound like self-sufficient human control.
changed_reading.after: It names limited human jurisdiction under a sovereignty that can replace the holder, so possession cannot erase accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the non-dominant mapped root is form-distant from the focus blame word. It remains packet-authorized and anchored at focus word 10, but downstream prose must present it only as a threshold resonance, never as the lexical meaning of the word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final focus word negates being blameworthy at the edge between authorized and overstepping conduct.

activation_trace.role: Approaching a minor wrong without fully committing it contributes a threshold image to the focus's negated blame.
Exception and negation anchor the threshold resonance in an expressly bounded focus construction.

changed_reading.before: Blame is a binary label attached after the act.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, non-blame also marks a threshold: the authorized relation stays on the permitted side before proximity becomes crossing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-lexeme root echo between the context's angels and the focus possession verb, not a claim that the words share one contextual sense. It remains anchored in the same packet root inventory and usefully checks autonomous mastery, but downstream prose must label the move analogical and form-distant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus possession verb can be tested against another same-root agent image already active in the surah.

activation_trace.role: The angel branch contributes an image of a powerful agent whose agency is nevertheless ordered toward God.
Ownership and disposal anchor the analogy in the focus's actual possession sense.

changed_reading.before: Possession presents the human holder as an autonomous controlling subject.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the same-root agent echo makes possession look like delegated agency under a higher order rather than absolute mastery.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because marital consummation is activated from the later verb for entering a garden. It remains anchored through the focus spouse and non-blame terms, but downstream prose must call it a cross-domain echo and must not imply that garden entry is sexual or that lawful intimacy guarantees salvation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins marital relation to a bounded declaration of non-blame, not to a total declaration of merit.

activation_trace.role: Marital entry within the broader entry root creates a cross-domain echo with the focus spouse relation.
The spouse branch anchors the entry echo in the focus's actual marital category.
Negated blame limits the focus claim to one conduct domain rather than promising comprehensive merit.

changed_reading.before: Lawful marital access can be heard as a self-contained positive credential.
changed_reading.after: The later denied expectation of entry contains the claim: non-blame in intimacy is a local verdict, not automatic admission or total righteousness.

strongest_changes: The 70:29-31 sequence turns the focus exceptions into authorized openings in a guarded perimeter whose far side is explicit limit-crossing.
Companionship keeps the spouse route reciprocal and distinct from the possession route.
Known rights, reckoning, and testimony make possession and non-blame accountable statuses rather than private license.
Trust and covenant activate stewardship and oath resonance, while the later right-versus-left contrast checks that resonance by restoring the literal right-hand base.
summary.what_was_special: The focus carries several live mechanisms at once: bounded legal exception, reciprocal pairing, rights-bearing possession, cohesive stewardship, and embodied right-hand agency. Context sharpens them without forcing one final interpretation, while split-root and cross-domain branches preserve contained exploratory readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from a known right in wealth to duties inside the focus possession relation is coherent but inferential.
The appetite model depends on cross-domain branches of touch and restraint that may remain secondary to their immediate adversity and wealth senses.
The oath resonance in right hands is activated by covenant language but constrained by the later literal right-left opposition.
The split-root, angel, and marital-entry outliers should not be rendered as lexical glosses.
